تختصرن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَصِرْنَ (taḵtaṣirna) /tax.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# تُخْتَصَرْنَ (tuḵtaṣarna) /tux.ta.sˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
